FICTIONAL RECEIPT DEMONSTRATION
A £126 purchase. One £37.80 item returned.

Add the purchase from its receipt.
Check the date and return window before saving.

Track the refund for the returned item.
The rest of this purchase keeps its return deadline.

The refund stays in an awaiting queue with your next check date.
The amount is your record, not a merchant or bank confirmation.

After checking that the money arrived, mark it received.
ReturnBy does not check your bank or send a payment.

The received refund and notes remain available to review or reopen.
Saved refund details also travel in your ReturnBy backup.
